name: Cozy Tavern
arrivalText: The scent of roasting meats, spiced cider, and a crackling hearth wraps around you as you push open the heavy oak doors.
description: A warm, bustling tavern with comfortable rooms, hot stews, and a crackling hearth. Sleep here to restore your stats and cure all ailments.
visualTheme: A warm, bustling rustic tavern with timber beams, a glowing stone fireplace, and comfortable beds smelling of lavender.

history.createdWhy: Built as a resting station along the old trade road between the capital and the forest colonies.
history.builtWho: Founded by Silas Senior, a retired vanguard soldier, and now run by his son Silas.
history.majorEvents: Served as a refuge for villagers during the Goblin Skirmishes.
history.whyExists: Remains the only safe haven for travellers entering the Whispering Wilds.
history.currentConflicts: Targeted by local bandits looking to pilfer imports from the trade routes.

ecosystem.weather: Warm and cozy indoors, light rain outside

npcs.name: Innkeeper Silas
dialogue: Welcome back, adventurer! Need a soft bed?
My father fought in the vanguard, but I prefer the peace of a warm stew.
Watch the roads to the east. Bandits are getting bolder.
